subject: english
question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Bureaucracy'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asassisnation, Philianthropist and Peadeatrician** do not exist in the English language.
 
• So, we can say that there are spelling mistakes in these words.
 
• Bureaucracy is a correct English word and means a system of government in which most of the important decisions are taken by state officials rather than by elected representatives.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Asassisnation **is correctly spelled as *assassination__*.** It means the action of assassinating someone.
 
• Philianthropist **is correctly spelled as *__philanthropist__*. **It means a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
 
• Peadeatrician **is correctly spelled as *__paediatrician__*. **It means a medical practitioner specializing in children and their diseases.
